purpose: AT3 classroom reproduction, general readable figures; no journal-specific compliance claim
canvas_note: Figure01 intentionally uses a tight bounding box with padding to retain all3D axis labels; exported pixel sizes are recorded per figure
transforms: threshold strictly >0.5; marching cubes level0.5; nominal1.6mm voxel; MIPs; absolute projection residual; log loss scale; no smoothing/mesh repair
sample_unit: one processed digital reference, one current run; three historical conditions on same case, not independent patients

figures.description: Inputs A/B share intensity limits. Lower surfaces use marching cubes at0.5, same camera and axes in nominal mm; no smoothing or connected-component removal. Occluded branches cannot be judged from this angle alone.

Top/middle are binary reference/reconstruction MIPs across all three axes; bottom projects voxel TP/FP/FN with priority FN over FP over TP. MIPs can hide depth and overlap, so Dice is calculated in3D, never from these pictures.

Per-view measured synthetic line integral, final forward projection and absolute residual; observed/reprojected share scales globally and residuals share a separate global scale. Good2D fit does not establish true3D accuracy.

Recorded pre-update MSE sampled every100 indices and final index; logarithmic y scale, no smoothing. The final reported projection MSE is evaluated after the final update and may differ from the last sampled pre-update loss.

Previously executed C0/C1/C2 results under the same initialization, resolution and author geometry. MIPs collapse axis2; scores are full3D Dice against reference A. C1/C2 perturbation input magnitudes differ, so their difficulty cannot be ranked.

software_reference: Kassis et al.2026, Scientific Agent Skills, arXiv2609.00065 https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065
